title:
Comment of Mike Farley in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/20/2026

documents.name: 151719.txt
documents.text:
Mike Farley, Portland, OR.
to whom it may concern,

I am writing in opposition to putting a Data Center in Maine's Bay of Fundy. Data Centers do not belong in the ocean. Data centers are are widely known to be loud, heat the water and pollute the water. Animals in these ecosystems do not need the added stress of these data centers on there already fragile ecosystems. The Bay of Fundy is a critical habitat for endangered North Atlantic Right Whales. These whales and other creatures need there natural habitat to remain nature to thrive. Lets be responsible and good stewards of the oceans and cancel any and all plans to place data centers in our oceans.

Thank you, 
Mike
